routes.title: ResilAI — Continuous Incident Readiness & Cybersecurity Verification Platform
routes.description: Transform fragmented security telemetry into deterministic readiness scoring, continuous compliance verification, and plain-English executive impact translation.
routes.h1: ResilAI: continuous incident readiness and cybersecurity verification
summary: ResilAI connects read-only to the systems a small organisation already runs, such as Microsoft 365, Entra ID, AWS, Veeam, CrowdStrike and Okta, and checks every day whether the safeguards that matter in an incident are really working.

Leaders get one plain-English answer each morning: if an incident happened today, could we keep operating and prove we were ready? Scoring is deterministic and every piece of evidence carries a SHA-256 hash.
ResilAI lists the laws and frameworks that apply where you operate: the United States, the European Union and United Kingdom, the Gulf states and Australia.

faq.q: Which US laws and frameworks does ResilAI cover?
faq.a: ResilAI maps live control evidence to the HIPAA Security Rule, NIST Cybersecurity Framework 2.0 and CIS Controls. For law firms it also references ABA Formal Opinion 477R and Model Rule 1.6(c). HIPAA is listed when you tell ResilAI that you handle protected health information.

faq.q: Does ResilAI make a US clinic HIPAA compliant?
faq.a: No tool can do that alone, and ResilAI does not certify compliance or give legal advice. It shows, every day, which HIPAA Security Rule safeguards your connected systems give evidence for and which ones need attention, so a risk assessment starts from facts.

faq.q: Can ResilAI help with a US cyber-insurance renewal?
faq.a: Yes. ResilAI fills in a cyber-insurance application from what your connected systems show today and puts the source and time beside every answer. You review, sign and send it.

faq.q: How is ResilAI priced in the United States?
faq.a: Plans are billed in US dollars through Stripe. The Founding plan is $149 per month for the first 50 customers, Growth is $399 per month, and Enterprise is a custom contract.

frameworks.name: GDPR

frameworks.note: Listed for organisations that operate in the United Kingdom and hold personal data.

frameworks.note: Listed as advisory. ResilAI shows evidence for measures such as multi-factor authentication and backup recovery.

frameworks.name: DORA (Regulation (EU) 2022/2554)
frameworks.note: Listed as mandatory for financial entities only.

frameworks.name: EU AI Act
frameworks.note: Listed when you use AI and have an EU presence. ResilAI keeps an inventory of your AI systems.

frameworks.name: ISO/IEC 27001 and ISO/IEC 42001
frameworks.note: Listed as advisory international standards for security management and AI management.

faq.q: Which European laws and frameworks does ResilAI cover?
faq.a: For the EU, ResilAI lists GDPR, the NIS2 Directive, DORA for financial entities and the EU AI Act for organisations that use AI. For the UK it lists UK GDPR and the Data Protection Act 2018. ISO/IEC 27001 and ISO/IEC 42001 are listed as advisory standards.

faq.q: Does NIS2 apply to my organisation?
faq.a: That depends on your sector and size, and ResilAI does not decide it for you. ResilAI lists NIS2 as advisory for organisations in the EU and shows which of its security measures your connected systems give evidence for, so you and your adviser can judge the gap.

faq.q: How does ResilAI help with the EU AI Act?
faq.a: When you use AI and have an EU presence, ResilAI lists the EU AI Act and keeps an inventory of the AI systems you use. The scoring itself is deterministic: AI is only used to explain verified findings in plain English.

faq.q: Does ResilAI make us GDPR or NIS2 compliant?
faq.a: No. ResilAI does not certify compliance or give legal advice. It shows which requirements your live evidence supports and which need attention, with a reason and an official link for every framework it lists.
